newsitem.title: UK: Monument, Mobil to negotiate Turkmenistan oil deal.
newsitem.headline: Monument, Mobil to negotiate Turkmenistan oil deal.

text.p: British oil explorer Monument Oil and Gas and U.S. Mobil Corp signed a memorandum of understanding on Monday with Turkmenistan for exclusive rights to negotiate a production sharing contract in the country's main hydrocarbon producing region, a Monument official said.

The two companies would start negotiations with state company Turkmaneft for a contract for exploration and further development of existing oilfields in a 20,000 square kilometer region of western Turkmenistan, Monument finance director Liz Arey said.
The region, from the Cheleken peninsula in the north to the Iranian border in the south, covers most of Turkmenistan's oil producing territory.
Monument already operates the small Nebit Dag production sharing concession in northern Turkmenistan in partnership with Mobil.
The U.S. company is expected to lead and operate any new agreement.
Turkmenistan produced about 110,000 barrels a day (bpd) of oil and gas condensates last year and is aiming to double output by 2000.
